limitations: Whole code sections prove bounded library provenance; they do not promote maintained source, exact units or semantic cases.
Imported function sizes and code/data boundaries are not overwritten by section sizes.
Byte-identical memcpy/memmove and narrow/multibyte string aliases retain name ambiguity.
Every applied binding comes from the reviewed prior CRT map or this section’s defined symbols; diagnostic inferred bindings are not accepted.
Cross-section bindings use only external symbol definitions from earlier fully verified sections. Later sections and candidate-derived relocation addresses are not binding authorities.

Additional sections are ordered by dependency. Complete equality corroborates pinned-library origin, not unique original library flags, alias spelling, source recovery or new configured exact functions.

Named PE import bindings are verified against the actual DLL/name/IAT cell. Forwarding thunks require their complete FF25 operand and retained REA byte or callee-body evidence; no SDK implementation or execution is claimed.
COFF stdcall spellings identify library references, not unique original source aliases or hardware/API success behavior.

Complete data definitions require either multiple independently established same-section symbols or a unique full initialized symbol as a discovery seed, followed by all bytes and relocations. Zero-only searches and inferred candidate addresses never establish placement.
Prior CRT entry exports become available only after their whole single-function sections pass against retained original bytes with the original reviewed relocation map.
